x: Charles V. Hemmings · Running · Michael J. Scammell · Walking
Two Belgravians competed; Steve White won the 200m in 22.5 and placed 2nd in the long jump with 6.84m, and M. Scammell clocked 14:44.2 to reach 2nd in the 3,000 metre walk.

Our Newham A.C. member, Mike Scammell is another who is forcing his way to the front and will soon be a name to be reckoned with. So, with individual and team wins in this event Belgravians came away from Battersea Park proud to have collected a double victory in this London Championship.
